boxes.meaning: take out of a bag or box

english.meaning: take out of a bag or box
english.note: Use this instead of 拆行李 when unpacking the contents of a box or parcel.

examples.english: I’ll unpack my new computer when I get home.
examples.traditional: 新買部電腦，返到屋企先拆箱。
